panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct personal users in the selected time range.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  uniqExact(tag_value) AS value
FROM grafana_tag_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND tag_key = 'sw_user_key'

panels.title: Total conversations
panels.description: Total QMS conversation events.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  sum(events) AS value
FROM grafana_log_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND component = 'qms.telemetry.conversation'

panels.title: Conversation success rate
panels.description: Conversation success percentage.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  round(sumIf(events, tag_value = 'success') * 100 / nullIf(sum(events), 0), 2) AS value
FROM grafana_tag_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND component = 'qms.telemetry.conversation'
  AND tag_key = 'sw_status'

panels.title: Average conversation duration
panels.description: Average conversation duration in milliseconds.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  round(sum(value_sum) / nullIf(sum(value_count), 0), 0) AS value
FROM grafana_metric_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND component = 'qms.telemetry.conversation'
  AND metric_key = 'duration_ms'

panels.title: QMS event trend
panels.description: QMS event volume by event type.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time,
  tag_value AS metric,
  sum(events) AS value
FROM grafana_tag_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND tag_key = 'sw_event_type'
  AND (tag_value = 'conversation' OR tag_value = 'turn' OR tag_value = 'step' OR tag_value = 'perf' OR tag_value = 'install')
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Token usage trend
panels.description: Input, output, and total token usage over time.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time,
  metric_key AS metric,
  sum(value_sum) AS value
FROM grafana_metric_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND component = 'qms.telemetry.turn'
  AND (metric_key = 'input_tokens' OR metric_key = 'output_tokens' OR metric_key = 'total_tokens')
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Duration P95 trend
panels.description: P95 duration by QMS telemetry component.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time,
  replaceOne(component, 'qms.telemetry.', '') AS metric,
  quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(value_p95_state) AS value
FROM grafana_metric_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND metric_key = 'duration_ms'
  AND startsWith(component, 'qms.telemetry.')
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Perf latency trend
panels.description: Average performance latency by perf metric.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time,
  tag_value AS metric,
  sum(value_sum) / nullIf(sum(value_count), 0) AS value
FROM grafana_tag_metric_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND metric_key = 'value_ms'
  AND tag_key = 'sw_perf_metric'
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Install stats by version and platform
panels.description: Install telemetry grouped by version and platform.
panels.querySql:
SELECT
  version,
  platform,
  arch,
  sum(events) AS total,
  sum(errors) AS failed,
  sum(events) - sum(errors) AS success,
  round((sum(events) - sum(errors)) * 100 / nullIf(sum(events), 0), 2) AS success_rate
FROM grafana_log_metrics_1m
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'
  AND product = '${product}'
  AND environment = '${environment}'
  AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
  AND component = 'qms.telemetry.install'
GROUP BY version, platform, arch
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 20
